title: Jennifer Lopez Is ‘So Proud’ of Her Two Kids—Meet Twins Emme and Max
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Jennifer Lopez Is ‘So Proud’ of Her Two Kids—Meet Twins Emme and Max
 The ‘Proof of Love’ artist welcomed her twins in 2008 with ex-husband Marc Anthony.
 Emma Banks Fri, 20 November 2026 at 3:30 pm UTC 7 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Max, Emme, and mom Jennifer Lopez at the "Kiss of the Spider Woman" screening on October 06, 2025.
Credit: TheStewartofNY/WireImage The Gist
 Jennifer Lopez welcomed twins Emme and Max on February 22, 2008 with her then-husband, Marc Anthony.
 The couple split in 2011, at which point Lopez became a single mom to their two kids.
 Emme and Max have described having a "special bond" with one another.
 Jennifer Lopez has always put her "best foot forward" for her kids, twins Emme and Max .
 Born on February 22, 2008 to the "On The Floor" singer and her then-husband Marc Anthony, the kids grew up in Lopez's hometown of New York City. Their arrival unlocked more than a new stage of life for the multi-hyphenate artist.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "It's unconditional love," Lopez once told People . "I know everybody feels this way about their kids, but I just feel like they're super special. I can't wait to see what they do."
 Following her and Anthony's divorce in 2011, and Lopez's rekindled romance with Ben Affleck in 2021, Emme and Max grew up in a blended family. Lopez and Affleck were married from 2022 until their divorce was finalized in early 2025. Lopez, for her part, has been candid about navigating single parenthood. "[I've asked], 'Am I enough for them?' " Lopez shared in a 2024 interview with Entertainment Weekly . "And the truth is, all you need is really one good parent to love you."
 Jennifer Lopez with her kids Emme and Max. 
 Credit: Instagram/@jlo 
 Emme and Max turned 18 in February 2026, and began college later that year—leaving Lopez's longtime fans wondering where the time went. The mom of two has had the same feeling herself. "I still have on my phone [a picture of] them on my lap as babies," she shared in a November appearance on The Tonight Show With Jimmy Fallon . "It goes so fast, just like everybody says," she added.
 From their early years in NYC to their new chapter as college students, the Lopez twins have come a long way. Ahead, learn everything there is to know about Jennifer Lopez's two kids, Emme and Max.
 Emme and Max grew up in the spotlight.
 Marc Anthony and Jennifer Lopez on stage with their kids in 2009. 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 Emme and Max were born in 2008, following the release of Lopez's album Brave . One year after their arrival, the twins joined their parents on stage at Madison Square Garden . In a 2023 interview with People , Lopez said that growing up with famous parents was "a lot for them," but that they "handled it with a lot of grace."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Now that the twins are older, they're ready to claim a little of the spotlight for themselves. For the opening night of Othello on Broadway in March 2025, for example, Lopez was joined by Emme in a rare public appearance that saw them wearing cute coordinated looks. Later the same year, Max and Emme joined their A-list mom at a screening of her film Kiss of the Spider Woman .
 They were homeschooled.
 Despite her busy schedule, Lopez opted to homeschool her children so that they'd be able to join her on tour. "Everybody's like, 'You should have them in school, they need friends,' " she said in a 2018 interview , People reports. "It can drive you crazy."
 Still, Lopez said it was important for her to be hands-on and spend as much time as she could with her kids, knowing how fast they would grow up. She added, "they are super happy, well-adjusted, loving, caring kids, and that's the most important thing." More recently, they've started to pursue higher education, a milestone Lopez loves to celebrate. "I am so proud that they set goals for themselves," Lopez said of her twins in a 2026 interview with Extra . "They all got into all five colleges that they applied to…Each one got a scholarship to a school."
 Their teenage years were a challenge for Lopez.
 With the baby years behind her, Lopez admitted that raising two teenagers isn't always easy. "It's challenging," she said during an appearance on Live with Kelly and Mark . "You have this baby for a while and then it's like, your best little friend who loves being with you all the time, and then all of a sudden it's like, 'Get out of my room.'" She explained how teenagers tend to challenge what their parents say and do, but the key to surviving those years is "riding the waves."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Challenges aside, Lopez considers motherhood a gift. On Mother's Day in 2024, she penned a tribute to her twins on Instagram , in which she called Max and Emme the "most beautiful blessing" in her life. Before the twins left for college, they enjoyed a road trip with their mom, who still refers to them as her "coconuts" in the caption.
 Max inspired Lopez to engage with Black Lives Matter.
 Jennifer Lopez and Max at home. 
 Credit: Instagram/@jlo 
 Following the death of George Floyd in 2020, Lopez was inspired to act by her son, Max. "He wanted me to make sure I realized that I had power and that I should use it, and I thought that was very insightful," she told Elle in 2021. "It was one of those parenting moments when you're like, 'Oh, maybe I'm raising a conscientious, kind, loving kid here.'"
 Lopez and her then-fiancé Alex Rodriguez joined some protests in L.A., where she brought along a homemade poster inspired by one of her songs, "Let's Get Loud." Both Lopez and Rodriguez later documented the day on Instagram.
 Emme is following in Lopez's artistic footsteps.
 Jennifer Lopez and Emme at Barrymore Theatre. 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 In 2020, Emme joined Lopez on one of the world's biggest stages: the Super Bowl halftime show. The duo then belted out Lopez's hit single "Let's Get Loud." "My lil' coconut gave me all the energy I needed to go out there!" Lopez later wrote on her Instagram Stories.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Emme has also penned a children's book, Lord Help Me , which covered the topic of prayer. "I really hope children are able to learn to pray, share the book and spread the power of prayer after reading it," Emme told People following the book's release in 2020.
 Emme and Max have a special relationship.
 In a 2020 interview with People , Emme confirmed that the twin connection is truly second to none. "Max and I have a special relationship," Emme explained. "Since we were very little, I could always understand him when no one else could."
 Lopez and Affleck enlisted the twins to help with their wedding.
 Ben Affleck and Jennifer Lopez at the premiere of 'This Is Me...Now: A Love Story.' 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 Twenty years after they first fell in love, Lopez and Affleck (finally) tied the knot in July 2022. The wedding was a family affair. All five children (Lopez has two and Affleck has three) walked down the aisle before Lopez processed. The couple later filed for divorce on their second wedding anniversary.
 "We weren't only marrying one another; we were marrying these children into a new family," she wrote in a special issue of her newsletter, On The JLo . "They were the only people we asked to stand up for us in our wedding party. To our great honor and joy, each one did."
 The twins are now college students.
 Jennifer Lopez and her two kids in a 2026 selfie. 
 Credit: @jlo 
 Hard as it is to believe, Lopez's kids are all grown up. They had their high school graduation in May 2026 (at which time Emme seemingly revealed a name change ). And in the fall, Lopez dropped them off at college, wrapping up a time she admits was emotional for her.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I cried for six months straight," she said in her November The Tonight Show appearance. "From two months before they graduated [high school] until I dropped them off [at college] and a few weeks after that."Nevertheless, she's since embraced the "freedom" of being an empty-nester and a single woman. "It's the first [time] since I was, I don't know, in my early 20s that I haven't been with someone, had my kids," the The JLO Show star said. "I'm alone, I'm free—I can do whatever the f--- I want! And it's kind of amazing, but also weird."
